_ test_real_capture_gap_bypasses_blocked_fifo_retires_both_slots_and_new_source_progresses[known_loss-self] _

channel = 'self', gap = 'known_loss'

    @pytest.mark.asyncio
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("channel", ["self", "peer"])
    @pytest.mark.parametrize("gap", ["known_loss", "epoch"])
    async def test_real_capture_gap_bypasses_blocked_fifo_retires_both_slots_and_new_source_progresses(
        channel, gap
    ):
        transport = FaultTransport()
        async with capture_runtime(channel, transport) as env:
            for value in (0.1, 0.2):
                await utterance(env, value)
            await wait_until(
                lambda: len(transport.sockets) == 2
                and all(finish_sent(socket) for socket in transport.sockets)
            )
            old_sockets = list(transport.sockets)
            engine = env.factory.engines[0]
            old_authority = engine._authority_generation
            if channel == "self":
                await old_sockets[1].push(native(old_sockets[1].task_ids[0], text="queued old update"))
                await wait_until(
                    lambda: any(turn.pending_update is not None for turn in engine._turns.values())
                )
            env.sink.cancelled_dispatch_gate = asyncio.Event()
            await utterance(env, 0.25)
            await asyncio.sleep(0.01)
            assert transport.attempts == 2
    
            class NoOnsetVad:
                chunk_samples = 8
    
                def process_chunk(self, _chunk):
                    return []
    
            now = asyncio.get_running_loop().time()
            frames = []
            for index in range(2):
                capture = replace(
                    span(index, index * 8, (index + 1) * 8),
                    capture_epoch=1 if index == 0 or gap == "known_loss" else 2,
                    source_start_monotonic_s=now + index * 0.001,
                    source_end_monotonic_s=now + index * 0.001 + 8 / 16000,
                    discontinuity_before=(
                        AudioCaptureDiscontinuity("known_loss", now, 8)
                        if index and gap == "known_loss"
                        else None
                    ),
                )
                frames.append(AudioFrameF32(np.full(8, 0.4, dtype=np.float32), 16000, capture=capture))
            gap_task = asyncio.create_task(
                run_audio_vad_loop(
                    source=FakeAudioSource(frames),
                    vad=NoOnsetVad(),
                    sink=env.guarded,
                    target_sample_rate_hz=16000,
                    channel_label=channel,
                )
            )
            try:
                await wait_until(lambda: engine._authority_generation > old_authority)
                await asyncio.wait_for(env.sink.cancelled_dispatch.wait(), timeout=0.5)
                assert not gap_task.done()
                for socket in old_sockets:
                    await socket.push(native(socket.task_ids[0], 99, "OLD_AFTER_DISCONTINUITY"))
                    await socket.push(control(socket.task_ids[0], "task-finished"))
            finally:
                env.sink.cancelled_dispatch_gate.set()
>               await asyncio.wait_for(gap_task, timeout=0.5)

_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _

self = <puripuly_heart.core.runtime.self_capture._GenerationGuardedVadSink object at 0x000001CA4B09F4D0>
event = CaptureStreamInput(chunk=array([], dtype=float32), capture=(), boundary_reason='source_discontinuity', speech_observed=False)

    async def handle_stream_input(self, event: CaptureStreamInput) -> None:
        if not self.owner.is_current_generation(self.capture_generation.value):
            return
        qwen_discontinuity = (
            self.ledger.settings.provider_id == "qwen_audio"
            and event.boundary_reason == "source_discontinuity"
        )
        if self.ledger.settings.provider_id not in {"gemini_transcribe", "rolling_free"}:
            if not qwen_discontinuity:
                return
            event = replace(event, chunk=event.chunk[:0], capture=())
            self._closing = True
            if self._worker is not None and not self._worker.done():
                self._worker.cancel()
        if not qwen_discontinuity:
            if self._worker is None:
                self._worker = asyncio.create_task(self._run(), name="self-vad-dispatch")
            elif self._worker.done():
                await self._worker
                raise RuntimeError("self VAD dispatch worker stopped")
        if event.capture:
            self.owner._current_stream_capture_epoch = event.capture[-1].capture_epoch
        elif event.boundary_reason == "source_discontinuity":
            self.owner._current_stream_capture_epoch = None
        capture_epoch = self.owner._current_stream_capture_epoch
        owned = OwnedStreamInput(
            event=event,
            ledger=self.ledger,
            settings=self.ledger.settings,
            activation_generation=self.capture_generation.value,
            retention=AudioRetentionBinding(
                budget=self.retention_budget,
                dispatcher_owner=object(),
            ),
            is_current=lambda: (
                self.owner.is_current_generation(self.capture_generation.value)
                and (
                    event.boundary_reason is not None
                    or self.owner._current_stream_capture_epoch == capture_epoch
                )
            ),
        )
        if qwen_discontinuity:
            try:
                await cast(_VadSink, self.sink).handle_stream_input(owned)
            finally:
                retired = await self.abort()
                self._worker = None
                self._closing = False
                if self.owner.is_current_generation(self.capture_generation.value):
                    for receipt in retired:
>                       await cast(_VadSink, self.sink).handle_source_segment_retired(receipt)
                              ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
E                       AttributeError: 'BoundaryRuntimeSink' object has no attribute 'handle_source_segment_retired'
